name: Fanart.tv API
tagline: High-quality fan-made movie, TV, and music artwork by TMDB/TVDB/MusicBrainz IDs
description: Fanart.tv provides a REST API for retrieving high-quality, community-created artwork for movies, TV shows, and music. Images are keyed by external IDs (TMDB for movies, TVDB for series, MusicBrainz for artists/albums/labels) and include posters, logos, backgrounds, banners, clearart, and more. Developers authenticate with a personal API key; the free tier allows limited usage, with Project VIP membership raising rate limits.

auth.details: Personal API key via api_key query parameter (or X-API-Key header on some endpoints). Obtain free key after account registration at fanart.tv; Project VIP membership increases limits.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free API key with limited rate; exact free quota not clearly published on current docs
pricing.paid_plans: Project VIP membership increases API rate limits and adds site benefits; pricing not detailed on API docs

rate_limits: not published precisely; free tier more limited than Project VIP
use_cases: fetch movie posters and logos by TMDB ID
get TV show clearart and banners by TVDB ID
retrieve artist backgrounds and logos by MusicBrainz ID
pull album covers and CD art for a music library
enrich media center UIs with fan-made artwork
